reviewer: Independent Korean reviewer, separate from translation writer
review_scope: Read and independently compared all 202 complete ordered Chinese/Korean paragraph pairs, including every example, quotation, argument, exception, qualification and conclusion.
Compared all titles, decks, chapter labels and full entry doors. Verified identifiers, source_sha256, counts, source href and chapter consistency with reviewed Korean index.

Reviewed revisable understanding versus fixed explanation, emotional comfort versus responding to reasons, interpretations versus the persons own account, familiarity and change, and meaningful participation without guaranteed agreement.
Verified qualifications about self-deception, evidence, long-term commitments, responsibility for changes, and emotional presentation not determining validity.
Made two localized precision corrections, reread the final paragraphs in source context, and retained all other text after semantic comparison.
limitations: Korean11–15 only; not other languages, later batches, public HTML, rendering or aggregate publication acceptance.
AI linguistic review, not native-speaker editorial certification.

findings.finding: 相爱 is explicitly mutual, whereas 사랑하기 left mutuality implicit.
findings.resolution: Added 서로 to preserve loving each other.

findings.finding: 내가 더 편안하게 살도록 could make the speaker rather than the other person the beneficiary of arranging a comfortable life; 배치해 줄 was also unnatural here.
findings.resolution: Specified 그의 삶을 더 편안하게 꾸려 주기 to identify whose life is arranged, preserving the contrast with that persons own judgment and participation.

findings.finding: No additional correction required after full source comparison.
findings.resolution: Retained argument order, examples, qualifications, chapter terminology and source link.
